cells.normalized_text: While Airborne and having a Class Ability Charge: [Air Move] consumes a Class Ability Charge to perform an upwards Arc Staff Twirl. Triggers the effects of the equipped Class Ability on usage. Grants Amplified to the user and allies within 10 meters. Deals up to 181 [?] damage, as well as Jolting enemies within 10 metres. Aspect's Damage scales with Class Stat above 100, up to 65% [?%] at 200 Stat.

scope: Provenance for partial Ascension reference content, shared dodge benefits and accepted class-ability classification; calibration and remaining content gaps are tracked in ascension.json.

findings: Ascension now counts as a class ability for all perks and abilities.
Detonation damage scales with Class stat above 100.
Prismatic Ascension can activate Winters Shroud on cast.

engine_requirement: Air Move input consumes the currently equipped class ability declared cost once, retaining the actual air-action identity and payment receipt. This does not implicitly execute the donor skill or trigger a second cast.
pending: 3米碰撞位移、0.2秒收益延迟、Guardian伤害7及其无额外Class倍率均为合成校准；原作竖直速度/高度、动画时点、PvP伤害与Class曲线、范围衰减、伤害单位投影仍未确定。
181是表格最大战员伤害，当前10米内统一采用该最大值；100–200 Class线性插值只在校准夹具，原表/Clarity仅支持65%上限。共享Amplified 15秒及Jolt 10/5秒沿用现有状态模板，来源特例和完整缩放待校准。
初次爆炸会进入新Jolt的计数；该时序、免疫/取消/致死的状态资格、范围内先后死亡和多个Jolt连锁的原作边界仍需校准。
Arc Staff内重复Ascension的超能支付尚未实现；Marksman的15米弹药砖拾取、Acrobat’s Dodge等其余职业技能收益、Winter’s Shroud及完整金装/碎片/模组交互待接线。闪身的追踪/瞄准辅助规避窗口未作为Ascension收益继承，需独立原作证据。
参考定义仍在测试资源；正式Aspect/子职业目录、装备约束、空中动作键位/UI/动画/素材、物理世界跨重启恢复尚未完成。纯领域检查点不代表世界持久化。
